copy.tagline: 测试黄金聊天话题构建
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要验证黄金聊天话题构建功能
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify the golden chat topics build

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以访问一个固定的 Discord 聊天历史（包含3条消息、2位用户、1个 #help 频道），并根据其中的内容回答关于设置、故障排除和一般讨论的问题。
howto.when: 当你要求测试 golden_chat_topics golden 构建，或直接询问该聊天历史中的具体信息（如设置步骤、故障处理方法）时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看 Discord 聊天历史里关于设置的讨论。
say.note: Claude 会读取 setup 相关消息。

say.text: 这个聊天记录中有哪些故障排除步骤？
say.note: Claude 会查找 troubleshooting 内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can access a fixed Discord chat history (3 messages, 2 users, 1 #help channel) and answer questions about setup, troubleshooting, and general discussion based on its content.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to test the golden_chat_topics golden build, or directly inquire about specific information from this chat history, such as setup steps or troubleshooting methods.

say_en.text: Show me the discussions about setup in the Discord chat history.
say_en.note: Claude will read the setup-related messages.

say_en.text: What troubleshooting steps are in this chat log?
say_en.note: Claude will look up troubleshooting content.
